metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: T01 (TRL 6) and T05 (TRL 6) each have ~2 year development windows which are reasonable for process-category technologies; T02 (TRL 7) with a 2-year window to completion is slightly aggressive but acceptable given its higher starting TRL and dependency on T01.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for exploratory, lower-TRL R&D-heavy investment, but the portfolio consists entirely of mid-to-high TRL technologies (TRL 6-7) with commercialization-ready characteristics, suggesting insufficient exploratory depth for true technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three selected technologies (synthetic data generation, multi-sensor fusion, HDR/blur processing) are firmly within the AI Vision/ADAS/Computer Vision domain, reflecting solid domain fit; however, there is little explicit evidence of competitor gap analysis or differentiation positioning beyond core capability building.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completions should ideally precede market booms by 1-2 years; T05 completes 0.5 years early (good), T01 completes 0.75 years late (mild miss), and T02 completes 2.0 years after its boom window (significant miss), dragging overall timing performance down.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are reasonable candidates for patent-market convergence in ADAS/CV, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence that convergence-zone analysis drove selection; the choices appear domain-logical but not demonstrably convergence-targeted.

strengths: All selected technologies are squarely within the AI Vision/ADAS domain, ensuring the company competes where it has established advantage.
Zero dependency violations and full budget utilization indicate well-structured execution planning with T01 correctly gating T02.
weaknesses: T02 (다중 센서 퓨전 아키텍처) completes 2.0 years after its market boom window, severely undermining the technology leadership positioning.
The portfolio lacks any low-TRL exploratory technologies, which is inconsistent with a 기술선도 strategy and leaves no long-horizon innovation pipeline.
missing_technologies: Low-TRL (TRL 2-4) next-generation perception technologies such as neuromorphic vision sensors or event-camera-based perception to anchor true technology leadership.
Edge AI inference optimization / on-device model compression technology to complement sensor fusion for deployment competitiveness.
Adversarial robustness and OOD (out-of-distribution) detection for perception safety — a critical differentiator in ADAS competitive landscape.
investment_issues: Both T01 and T02 are classified as 'Strategic' tier, but T02's 2-year post-boom completion makes Strategic-tier investment difficult to justify on market return grounds.
T05 receives only 'High' tier investment despite having the best timing alignment and urgency score of 5.0, suggesting possible under-investment in the most timely asset.
No budget allocation for exploratory (TRL 1-4) technologies means the 기술선도 strategy has no long-term innovation hedge, concentrating all spend on near-term assets.
timing_issues: T02 completes in 2030-Q1 but its market boom is 2028-Q1, a 2.0-year lag that means the technology arrives after market momentum has peaked, negating first-mover advantage.
T05 completes in 2027-Q1, which is 0.5 years before its boom — marginally early for 기술선도, but the development window of only 1 year for a TRL 6 process technology may create quality/maturity risk.
